sentences.text: Rajya Pratibha Khoj Pariksha Chhatravriti Yojana

**Scheme Brief Description:** Under this scheme, students are provided with scholarships or a one-time incentive for pursuing education up to the postgraduate level, after being selected through the State Talent Search Examination organized by the Board of Secondary Education Rajasthan, Ajmer.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Education & Learning; Sector: Universities and higher education

**Detailed Description:** The scheme &quot;Rajya Pratibha Khoj Pariksha Chhatravriti Yojana&quot; was implemented by the Secondary Education Department, Government of Rajasthan. Under this scheme, students are provided with scholarships or a one-time incentive for pursuing education up to the postgraduate level, after being selected through the State Talent Search Examination organized by the Board of Secondary Education Rajasthan, Ajmer. Students studying in Classes 10 and 12 in all government schools, recognized private schools, and Swami Vivekanand Model Schools in the state, who have secured a minimum of 50% marks in Classes 9 and 11 respectively, are eligible to apply for the examination. Students selected through this examination will be entitled to the benefits provided under the scheme.

**Benefits / Assistance:** **Type of Benefit: Scholarship and One-Time Incentive** **Class at the time of application****No. of Selected Students &amp;amp;amp; Basis of Selection Basis****Scholarship Rate (For a period of 10 Months)****One-Time Incentive (20 students in each)**Class 10th50 students (≥80% marks)₹1,250/month (for Class 11-12)₹4,000 for topper, ₹2,000 each for othersClass 12th - Arts50 students (≥80% marks)₹2,000/month (for UG &amp;amp;amp; PG)₹4,000 for topper, ₹2,000 each for othersClass 12th - Commerce50 students (≥80% marks)₹2,000/month (for UG &amp;amp;amp; PG)₹4,000 for topper, ₹2,000 each for othersClass 12th - Science50 students (≥80% marks)₹2,000/month (for UG &amp;amp;amp; PG)₹4,000 for topper, ₹2,000 each for others**NOTE:** - Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the beneficiary’s bank account. - Monthly (for up to 10 months per academic year).

**Application Process:** **Step 1:** To avail of the benefits of the scheme, the applicant needs to contact their respective school or college administration. **Step 2:** Submit copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required) to the school/college. **Step 3:** The school will visit the [Shala Darpan, Rajasthan](https://rajshaladarpan.rajasthan.gov.in/SD4/Home/Public2/Default.aspx) Portal. **Step 4:** Using the school&#39;s login credentials (Login ID and Password), the school will fill and submit the application form.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Education (Elementary and Secondary) Department
